name: 93725 · Fresno, CA
findings: ZIP 93725 (Fresno) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93725 (Fresno) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93725 (Fresno) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 38% of the typical level).
